negative_tests: Change a direct-edit original_text so it is missing from exact_text; preflight-frus-checker-plan.mjs must fail.
Change a status claim to direct-edit `printed in` for a target still being cleared; preflight-frus-status-claims.mjs must fail.
Give extract-frus-status-claims.mjs status text with a direct publication-status edit but no exact target; preflight-frus-status-claims.mjs must fail.
Give audit-frus-authority-usage.mjs an authority-control direct edit for a cross-volume or variant Persons form; it must fail.
Give validate-frus-authority-registry.mjs a duplicate authority_item_id or malformed authority-registry schema; it must fail.
Give audit-frus-source-list-usage.mjs a direct edit for a cross-volume or variant source-list form; it must fail.
Give validate-frus-source-list-registry.mjs a duplicate source_item_id or malformed source-list-registry schema; it must fail.
Give audit-frus-document-metadata-usage.mjs a direct edit for a cross-volume or variant heading/date/subject form; it must fail.
Give validate-frus-document-metadata-registry.mjs a duplicate document_metadata_id or malformed document-metadata-registry schema; it must fail.
Give build-frus-llm-review-packet.mjs a malformed extracted-units file; it must fail before producing a model packet.
Make a chunk output reference a unit assigned to another chunk; merge-frus-checker-chunks.mjs must fail.
Point audit-frus-review-coverage.mjs at checker output with an unknown unit id; it must fail.
Add an unmapped angle token such as <foo> to extracted text; preflight-frus-pseudo-markers.mjs must fail.
Remove word/document.xml from a DOCX package; extract-frus-docx-units.mjs must fail.
Change a comment-only unit to comment_safety unsafe; apply-frus-word-comments.mjs must fail.
Remove a generated commentRangeEnd marker; validate-frus-docx-output.mjs must fail.
Point run-frus-offline-review.mjs at checker output with unit ids not present in the extracted DOCX; the wrapper runner must fail during preflight.
Remove the checks array from checker-output-v1; validate-frus-checker-output.mjs and build-frus-evidence-queue.mjs must fail.
Remove any required file listed in the manifest; verify-frus-offline-bundle.mjs must fail.
